Take Back the Sword and Shield'') is the 37th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{Henry}} and [[Arman|Kubfu]] pass the [[Tower of Waters]] and Kubfu evolves into {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Urshifu|Rapid Strike Style}} {{p|Urshifu}}. * Henry is given Urshifu from [[Mustard]]. * [[Hop]] rides {{p|Moltres}} to the [[Isle of Armor]] and encounters Henry and {{Casey}}. * Moltres is revealed to have found the [[Rusted Shield]]. * Moltres carries Henry and the Rusted Shield to the [[Crown Tundra]]. * Henry finds [[Bede]] and they head back to [[Freezington]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Urshifu}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Urshifu|Rapid Strike Style}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Henry Sword|Henry]] * [[Casey Shield|Casey]] * [[Hop]] * [[Bede]] * [[Marnie]] (flashback) * [[Mustard]] * [[Peony]] * [[Marvin]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Gurdurr}} (Steeler; [[Henry Sword|Henry]]'s) * {{p|Toxtricity}} (Tera; {{form|Toxtricity|Low Key}}; [[Casey Shield|Casey]]'s) * {{p|Pincurchin}} ([[Hop]]'s) * {{p|Kubfu}} ([[Arman|Mustard]]'s; evolves) * {{p|Urshifu}} ([[Arman|Mustard]]'s; {{form|Urshifu|Rapid Strike Style}}; newly evolved; given to {{Henry}}) * {{p|Urshifu}} ([[Mustard]]'s; {{form|Urshifu|Single Strike Style}}) * {{p|Inteleon}} ([[Sniffler]]; [[Marvin]]'s) * {{p|Dracovish}} (Draco; [[Marvin]]'s) * {{p|Barraskewda}} * {{p|Sandygast}} * {{p|Pyukumuku}} * {{p|Tentacool}} * {{p|Tentacruel}} * {{p|Articuno}} ([[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; flashback) * {{p|Zapdos}} ([[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; flashback) * {{p|Moltres}} ([[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]) * {{p|Calyrex}} ([[Calyrex (game)|Adventures]]; silhouette) ==Trivia== {{stub|Manga}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PASS36 |prevtitle=Rrmbll!!
